## Problem and change

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran npm run check and npm test.
- [ ] Ran integration tests for rendering changes, or explained why unavailable.
- [ ] Reviewed contact sheet/affected previews before PPTX assembly where applicable.
- [ ] Updated relevant docs and CHANGELOG.
- [ ] Checked the diff for generated files, private data and machine-specific paths.

Include commands/results, visual evidence when useful, and remaining limitations.
